method: OpenAI built-in image_gen, strongly changed camera angle product illustrations
scope: High overhead, near side profile and opposite short-end views from original product identity references. Fine or unseen technical details may differ from physical goods.

records.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Product identity reference: input 1, original COLOP printer R40 orange round self-inking stamp and its orange round detachable cap. Input 2 is the CURRENT PICTURE TO DIFFER FROM: do NOT repeat this front three-quarter upright camera angle. Make a radically different yet realistic catalog photograph: camera high overhead at 65 degrees downward and 70 degrees around to the stamp's left side. Top black oval push surface is a major visible plane, front COLOP printer R40 label is foreshortened on the curved side. Stand stamp upright, place detached orange cap behind-left with its opening visible from above. Entire grey open frame must remain the same real mechanism. Strong foreshortening, visually unmistakably a high bird's-eye photograph, not merely swapping cap position or mirroring the old shot. Preserve original model, body proportions, orange/grey/black plastics, no extra buttons, no added decals, no invented underside/imprint. Realistic matte molded plastics and small soft highlights, restrained studio lighting, no exaggerated chrome, no stylization. Square canvas, complete objects centered with 15 percent padding. Transparent alpha background. No added captions or props.
